stops.note: Flight from Dublin to Paris. Transfer from Beauvais to Paris.
Stay around Porte Maillot. Visit the Eiffel Tower early in the morning.
Spend the morning/day in Paris, then take the 17:38 train from Gare de Lyon. Sleep in Marseille.
Spend time in Marseille until around 16:00. Pick up Peugeot 308 and drive to Hyères around 19:00.
Stay in the Airbnb and explore the area.
Car rental ends. Prepare for return journey.
Return flight from Marseille to Dublin.
